source.title: My Old Enemy
source.description:
I had heard that Caldoran was present at Naxxramas and I feared that if the battle turned, I'd be forced to the front lines alongside of him.

While the Argent Dawn is in support of you providing aid to the Scarlet Reclamation forces, I must warn you in the most strenuous terms; be wary of Baelin Caldoran. My hands shake with rage even thinking about that man and the atrocities he has visited on the innocent. He is NOT to be trusted. Please, I implore you, heed my words here.
source.objective: Learn more about Baelin Caldoran from Leonid Barthalomew the Revered.
source.progress: Caldoran is not to be trusted, ever.
source.completion:
That's all I will say on the matter for now. It took me years to crawl out of the pit of darkness inside my soul after what that man did to me.

We may be tentative allies now, but I will see Caldoran pay for his crimes... someday. My oath on this holds. In the meantime, be extremely careful in your dealings with him.
